mapper.select: update integration_schema.job_lease set owner_id=#{owner},fence_token=fence_token+1, lease_until=clock_timestamp()+(#{seconds} * interval '1 second'),heartbeat_at=clock_timestamp() where resource_key=#{resourceKey} and lease_until<clock_timestamp() returning fence_token
select fence_token from integration_schema.job_lease where resource_key=#{resourceKey} and owner_id=#{owner} and fence_token=#{token} and lease_until>clock_timestamp() for update
select owner_id,fence_token,lease_until<clock_timestamp() as expired from integration_schema.job_lease where resource_key=#{resourceKey} for update
mapper.update: update integration_schema.job_lease set lease_until='-infinity',owner_id=null where resource_key=#{resourceKey} and owner_id=#{owner} and fence_token=#{token}
